result:
The answer is 32, from my recollection of the literature rather than a derivation.

I recall a result (Kummer–Shaska line of work on Barth sextics) stating that every maximal nodal sextic, with 65 nodes, contains a symmetric half-even set of 32 nodes. That set yields a linear symmetric $6\times 6$ determinantal representation, with $X$ as the cokernel. I did not verify this by a parity or theta-characteristic computation, so treat it as a recalled value.

ANSWER: 32
